To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have assigned the NMR spectrum of Anabaena heterocyst ferrodoxin and have shown that it is a 4-helical protein.
we have assigned the 1H and 15N NMR resonances of the diamagnetic form of the ferredoxin from the cyanobacterium Anabaena 7112, using a combination of NOE and triple-resonance NMR experiments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure and function of ferredoxin, a small, soluble iron-sulfur protein found in all living things.
the structure of the heterocyst ferreoxins of cyanobacteria and the mechanism of their reduction.
the structure, function, and assembly of the iron-sulfur cluster proteins of the photosynthetic apparatus.

the structure of heterocyst ferreoxin has been determined in solution.
